description: Before-and-after delta against an agreed tolerance. Produced by reconciliation; checked by the realize→deploy Q-gate. First domain pack: finance/DTV — the schema itself is domain-neutral.

data_domain.description: Migration object(s) / data domain covered, e.g. 'FI: Universal Journal line items, 2026-08-01 load'.

agreed_tolerance.description: The tolerance agreed before the load ran — not chosen after seeing the result.

mismatch_cause.description: Required in practice whenever within_tolerance is false — a mismatch with no stated cause blocks the gate silently.
